
```{r}
require(tidyverse)
require(ComPoM)
require(sdmTMB)

load("fal_len.rda")
load("compare-predictions-only-ps.rda")
load("CPUE_out.RData")

dat.pred$pred  <- apply(pred,2,mean)

#dat.pred$pred.CPUE <-  dat.pred$pred/dat.pred$hhooks

dat.pred <- dat.pred %>%
  mutate( lond5 = lon5*sd(sdat5$lon5) + mean(sdat5$lon5) + 2.5,
          latd5 = lat5*sd(sdat5$lat5) + mean(sdat5$lat5) + 2.5,
          lat10 = 10 * floor(latd5 / 10),
          lon10 = 10 * floor(lond5 / 10),
          yy = as.factor(yy))  %>% 
  filter(lat10>-30,lat10<=10,lon10 > 120)


    
#   sout <- predict(bmod, 
#                   bmod$data %>% mutate(NINA4_MA4 = 0),
#                   re_formula = "~(1 | yy)", 
#                   allow_new_levels=T)
  
#   bmod$data$scpue <- sout[,1]
#   scaled_LFs_CPUE <- scale_comps(fit = LFs_pois_fit, scale_df = 
#                                     bmod$data %>% mutate(meiv2=0), 
#                                   grps = c('yy', 'meiv2'), 
#                                   form = "yy", predvar="scpue")


sst <- readRDS(file = "sst-long-5x5.rds") %>% 
    rename(
        lond5 = x, 
        latd5 = y) %>%
            mutate(mm=month, 
                   yy=year(mdate))


switch.lon.360 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), NA, ifelse(x<0, x + 360, x)) # switch lon from -180-180 to 0-360
 
model_data_fal <- data_prep(fal_len |>
    filter(len>=50, len<=300) |>
    mutate(bin = cut(len, c(0,seq(50, 200, by=20),300))) |> 
    mutate(
        lond5 = as.numeric(lond5),
        latd5 = as.numeric(latd5),
        count=1,
        bin=as.numeric(gsub("\\(([0-9]*),.*","\\1",bin))) |> 
    filter(!is.na(bin),bin>0) |>  
    inner_join(sst),
    #bin_width = 20,
    min_n = 10, 
    vars_for_grouping = c("set_type",'mm','yy', 'latd5', 'lond5', 'sst')) %>% 
        mutate(lond5 = switch.lon.360(lond5)) %>% 
        filter(yy>=2010,yy<=2020)

    model_data_fal %>% group_by(yy) %>% summarise(n=sum(tot_by_bin))
    model_data_fal %>% group_by(yy, set_type) %>% summarise(n=sum(tot_by_bin))
    model_data_fal_ps <- model_data_fal %>% filter(set_type=="ASSOC")


```


```{r}
ad <- bind_rows(model_data_fal_ps[, c("lond5", "latd5")],
                dat.pred[dat.pred$set_type=="ASSOC", c("lond5", "latd5")]) %>% distinct()

all_locs_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(ad, coords = c("lond5", "latd5"))
bnd <- fmesher::fm_nonconvex_hull(all_locs_sf, convex = -0.1, format = 'sf')

msh <- fmesher::fm_mesh_2d(
    model_data_fal_ps[, c("lond5", "latd5")], 
    max.edge = 10,
    boundary = bnd, 
    )

mesh <- make_mesh(model_data_fal_ps, xy_cols = c("lond5", "latd5"), mesh = msh)

bnd_vect <- terra::vect(bnd)
pg <- terra::rast(bnd_vect)

plot(mesh)
```

```{r scaled-compositions-setup}
library(cowplot)
source("stan_setup.r")
expose_functions(bmod, vectorize = TRUE)

# ── 1. CPUE prediction grid ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Build a spatial grid of unique locations from the prediction data
spatial_grid <- dat.pred |>
  dplyr::distinct(lon5, lat5) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(lon5), !is.na(lat5))

model_yrs <- as.character(sort(unique(as.integer(
  as.character(fal_nospatial$data$yy)
))))

# Expand grid: one row per location x year
pred_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  spatial_grid,
  yy = model_yrs
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # SST: use mean SST from training data per year
    SST   = 0,
    NINA4_MA4 = 0,
    sets  = 1,  # dummy variable for prediction 
    yy    = factor(yy, levels = model_yrs)
  )

```

```{r cpue-prediction}
# ── 2. Predict CPUE from bmod on the spatial grid ────────────────────────────
# re_formula = "~(1|yy)" keeps only the year RE; marginalises over program etc.
cpue_pred <- posterior_epred(
  bmod,
  newdata      = pred_grid,
  re_formula   = ~ (1 | yy),
  allow_new_levels = FALSE
)
# cpue_pred: draws x locations matrix — use posterior mean as CPUE weight
pred_grid_bmod <- pred_grid |>
  dplyr::mutate(catch = colMeans(cpue_pred))

```

```{r scale-df-construction}
# ── 3a. scale_df: catch-weighted, SST at observed values ─────────────────────
# Use dat.pred$pred (posterior mean predicted catch) as the catch weight.
# SST is the raw °C value matching fal_nospatial's sst column scale.
mean_sst_raw <- mean(fal_nospatial$data$sst, na.rm = TRUE)

scale_df_catch <- dat.pred |>
  dplyr::filter(as.character(yy) %in% model_yrs) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    catch = pred,# posterior mean predicted catch
    # Scale lon/lat using bmod training means/SDs
    lond5  = 5 * floor(lond5/5) + 2.5,
    latd5  = 5 * floor(latd5/5) + 2.5,
    sst   = SST * sd(exp(sdat5$SST), na.rm = TRUE) +
            mean(exp(sdat5$SST), na.rm = TRUE),   # back-transform to raw °C
    yy    = factor(yy, levels = model_yrs),
    mm    = factor(mm)
  ) |>
  group_by(yy, mm, lond5, latd5) |>
  summarise(catch = sum(catch), sst = mean(sst, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(catch), catch > 0)

# ── 3b. scale_df: CPUE-weighted, SST set to mean (remove oceanographic signal)
scale_df_cpue <- pred_grid_bmod |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sst = mean_sst_raw, # fix SST at training mean → spline ≈ 0
    # not used by scale_comps(): remove_nuisance = TRUE removes the month RE
    mm  = factor(levels(fal_nospatial$data$mm)[1]),
    lond5  = 5 * floor((lon5*sd(sdat5$lon5) + mean(sdat5$lon5))/5) + 2.5,
    latd5  = 5 * floor((lat5*sd(sdat5$lat5) + mean(sdat5$lat5))/5) + 2.5 ) |>
  dplyr::select(yy, mm, lond5, latd5, sst, cpue = catch)

```

```{r scale-comps-run}
# ── 4a. Scale WITH SST: catch-weighted, SST retained, month RE retained ──────
scaled_with_sst <- scale_comps(
  scale_df        = scale_df_catch,
  predvar         = "catch",
  fit             = fal_nospatial,
  grps            = c("yy", "mm", "lond5", "latd5"),
  remove_nuisance = FALSE
)

# ── 4b. Scale WITHOUT SST: CPUE-weighted, mean SST, month RE removed ─────────
scaled_without_sst <- scale_comps(
  scale_df        = scale_df_cpue,
  predvar         = "cpue",
  fit             = fal_nospatial,
  grps            = c("yy", "lond5", "latd5"),
  remove_nuisance = TRUE
)
```

```{r scaled-comp-plot, fig.dim=c(12, 8)}
# ── 5. Aggregate to annual and summarise across draws ─────────────────────────
summarise_scaled <- function(sc, label) {
  sc |>
    dplyr::group_by(yy, bin, .draw) |>
    dplyr::summarise(tot = sum(tot_by_bin, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::group_by(yy, .draw) |>
    dplyr::mutate(prop = tot / sum(tot)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(yy, bin) |>
    tidybayes::mean_qi(prop) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      bin    = as.numeric(as.character(bin)),
      source = label
    )
}

df_with    <- summarise_scaled(scaled_with_sst,    "A: Catch-weighted, SST retained, month RE retained")
df_without <- summarise_scaled(scaled_without_sst, "B: CPUE-weighted, SST = mean, month RE removed")

# Raw observed proportions from training data
raw_prop <- fal_nospatial$data |>
  dplyr::group_by(yy, bin) |>
  dplyr::summarise(tot = sum(tot_by_bin), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::group_by(yy) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    prop = tot / sum(tot),
    bin  = as.numeric(as.character(bin))
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# ── 6. Comparison plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dplyr::bind_rows(df_with, df_without) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(
    x = bin, y = prop, ymin = .lower, ymax = .upper,
    colour = source, fill = source
  )) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data         = raw_prop,
    ggplot2::aes(x = bin, y = prop),
    inherit.aes  = FALSE,
    colour       = "grey30", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~yy, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("steelblue", "firebrick"), name = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("steelblue", "firebrick"), name = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x        = "Length bin (cm)",
    y        = "Proportion",
    title    = "Scaled FAL compositions: with vs without SST effect",
    subtitle = "Grey dots = raw observed proportions | Ribbons = 95% posterior interval"
  ) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot(font_size = 9) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.x      = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7)
  )
```

```{r load-nina4}
# Load NINA4 index and join to composition data by yy + mm
load("nina4df.RData")

# Use NINA4 (raw index, not moving average)
ninadf <- ninadf |>
  dplyr::mutate(yy = as.numeric(as.character(yy)),
                mm = as.numeric(as.character(mm)))

model_data_fal_ps_nina <- model_data_fal_ps |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    ninadf |> dplyr::select(yy, mm, NINA4),
    by = c("yy", "mm")
  )

model_data_fal_ps_nina |>
  dplyr::group_by(yy) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n       = dplyr::n(),
                   n_na    = sum(is.na(NINA4)),
                   mean_n4 = round(mean(NINA4, na.rm = TRUE), 3))
```

```{r fit-nina4}
fal_nospatial_nina <- fit_model(
  re_form  = "mm",
  ffx_form = "yy",
  data     = model_data_fal_ps_nina,
  backend  = "TMB",
  priors   = sdmTMBpriors(b = normal(0, 10)),
  cvars    = c("sst", "NINA4"),
  spl      = "by_factor",
  knots    = "4",
  coords   = c("lond5", "latd5"),
  iter     = 1000,
  warmup   = 500,
  thin     = 2
)

sdmTMB::sanity(fal_nospatial_nina$model)
```

```{r cvar-smooth-plots, fig.dim=c(12, 10)}
p_sst  <- cvar_smooth_plot(fal_nospatial_nina, "sst") +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "SST smooth — multiplier on composition")

p_nina <- cvar_smooth_plot(fal_nospatial_nina, "NINA4") +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "NINA4 smooth — multiplier on composition")

cowplot::plot_grid(p_sst, p_nina, nrow = 2)
```

```{r scaled-compositions-setup}
library(cowplot)
source("stan_setup.r")
expose_functions(bmod, vectorize = TRUE)

spatial_grid <- dat.pred |>
  dplyr::distinct(lon5, lat5) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(lon5), !is.na(lat5))

model_yrs <- as.character(sort(unique(as.integer(
  as.character(fal_nospatial_nina$data$yy)
))))

pred_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(spatial_grid, yy = model_yrs) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    SST       = 0,
    NINA4_MA4 = 0,
    sets      = 1,
    yy        = factor(yy, levels = model_yrs)
  )
```

```{r cpue-prediction}
cpue_pred <- posterior_epred(
  bmod,
  newdata          = pred_grid,
  re_formula       = ~ (1 | yy),
  allow_new_levels = FALSE
)

pred_grid_bmod <- pred_grid |>
  dplyr::mutate(catch = colMeans(cpue_pred))
```

```{r scale-df-construction}
mean_sst_raw  <- mean(fal_nospatial_nina$data$sst,   na.rm = TRUE)
mean_nina_raw <- mean(fal_nospatial_nina$data$NINA4,  na.rm = TRUE)

# ── 3a. Catch-weighted: SST + NINA4 at observed values, month RE retained ─────
scale_df_catch_nina <- dat.pred |>
  dplyr::filter(as.character(yy) %in% model_yrs) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    catch = pred,
    lond5 = 5 * floor(lond5 / 5) + 2.5,
    latd5 = 5 * floor(latd5 / 5) + 2.5,
    sst   = SST * sd(exp(sdat5$SST), na.rm = TRUE) +
            mean(exp(sdat5$SST), na.rm = TRUE),
    yy    = factor(yy, levels = model_yrs),
    mm    = factor(mm)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    ninadf |>
      dplyr::mutate(yy = factor(as.character(yy), levels = model_yrs),
                    mm = factor(mm)) |>
      dplyr::select(yy, mm, NINA4),
    by = c("yy", "mm")
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(yy, mm, lond5, latd5) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    catch = sum(catch,              na.rm = TRUE),
    sst   = mean(sst,              na.rm = TRUE),
    NINA4 = mean(NINA4,            na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(catch), catch > 0, !is.na(NINA4))

scale_df_catch_nina %>% group_by(yy) %>% summarise(mean(NINA4))

# ── 3b. CPUE-weighted: SST + NINA4 set to mean, month RE removed ──────────────
scale_df_cpue_nina <- pred_grid_bmod |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sst   = mean_sst_raw,
    NINA4 = mean_nina_raw,
    mm    = factor(levels(fal_nospatial_nina$data$mm)[1]),
    lond5 = 5 * floor((lon5 * sd(sdat5$lon5) + mean(sdat5$lon5)) / 5) + 2.5,
    latd5 = 5 * floor((lat5 * sd(sdat5$lat5) + mean(sdat5$lat5)) / 5) + 2.5
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(yy, mm, lond5, latd5, sst, NINA4, cpue = catch)
```

```{r scale-comps-run}
# With SST + NINA4: catch-weighted, all effects retained
scaled_with_nina <- scale_comps(
  scale_df        = scale_df_catch_nina,
  predvar         = "catch",
  fit             = fal_nospatial_nina,
  grps            = c("yy", "mm", "lond5", "latd5"),
  remove_nuisance = FALSE
)

# Without SST + NINA4: CPUE-weighted, both cvars at mean, month RE removed
scaled_without_nina <- scale_comps(
  scale_df        = scale_df_cpue_nina,
  predvar         = "cpue",
  fit             = fal_nospatial_nina,
  grps            = c("yy", "lond5", "latd5"),
  remove_nuisance = TRUE
)
```
